backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for an NFT platform on the Internet Computer, managing collections, NFT items, user profiles, and minting with role-based access control via admin/user permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking two Gallery page UI changes (thinner borders and lighter serif quote text using Playfair Display) to their source file and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short summaries describing each component's or hook's purpose within the NFT art portfolio application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the UI.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the Istvan Seidel light-art portfolio SPA, setting German language, metadata, and mounting the React app at #root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (gallery, NFT detail, blog, admin, etc.) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider and Layout.
frontend/src/components/ActorErrorBanner: Alert banner component displayed when the backend actor fails to initialize, showing the error message and a retry button that reloads the page.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for admins to create or edit NFT collections, using create/update mutation hooks and displaying German-language toast notifications for success and error states.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of all NFT collections with edit and delete actions, using dialogs and alert dialogs for confirmation, and shows loading skeletons or an empty state when appropriate.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing an NFT, handling image upload with preview and progress, collection selection, price input, and submitting via create/update mutations.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and edit/delete controls, showing loading skeletons or an empty state when no NFTs exist.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Displays a single legacy artwork as a card with an image, title, and description, featuring hover scale and overlay animations.
frontend/src/components/BackendStatusInd: Small badge component that shows backend connectivity status (checking, online, or unreachable) based on a health check hook.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for displaying an on-chain minted NFT with its image, token ID, mint date, owner address, and optional 'my NFT' badge.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout wrapping pages with a sticky header (logo, navigation, login button), an actor error banner, main content area, and a footer with backend status and attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing a loading spinner during authentication and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top navigation bar component that renders nav links, conditionally shows an Admin link based on confirmed admin status, and provides a retry button on connection failure.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an individual NFT's image, title, collection name, price, and an optional ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component that displays an NFT collection's image, title, and description, linking externally to its Getgems marketplace page.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven predefined NFT collections (e.g., Lichtei, Wheel of Time) using NFTCollectionCard, each linking to Getgems.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal that shows a full NFT's image, metadata (title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price), and provides copy-to-clipboard fields and an ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section component with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture to educate users.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: React component that displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) with formatted values and a link to the ICP Explorer.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Displays an ICP principal address with optional shortening, a tooltip showing the full value, and a copy-to-clipboard button with toast feedback.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a StaticBlogPost interface and exports an array of static blog posts about light health topics (blue light, red light, wavelengths).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, initializing access control with an optional admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Hook that exposes whether the backend actor is fully initialized, setting an error state if readiness is not achieved within a 20-second timeout.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendHealthCheck: React Query hook that pings the backend via getAllCollections() every 60 seconds to determine backend availability.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been removed in favor of the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend to create a new NFT collection and invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a new NFT to the backend and returns the created NFT item, with auth error parsing and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT collection by ID and invalidates collection and item queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID and invalidates the NFT items query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy hook stub that returns an empty array for artworks, as the artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Legacy hook stub that returns an empty array for backend blog posts, allowing static blog posts to still render.
React Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, combining actor loading state with query loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: React Query hook that fetches all issued NFTs from the backend via listAllNFTs(), enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items from the backend actor, returning loading state combined with actor initialization state.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Stub hook replacing the old artwork backend; always returns null since artworks have been superseded by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Stub hook replacing the old category-based artwork backend; always returns an empty array.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Stub hook replacing the old blog backend; always returns null so static blog posts are used instead.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend, only running when the user is logged in and the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's issued NFTs via the backend actor's listMyNFTs method.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login, logout, identity, and status state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks whether the authenticated caller has admin permissions by calling the backend's isCallerAdmin method.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Admin-check hook with a phase-based state machine and configurable timeout, including a hardcoded principal fallback to avoid race conditions during actor initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the backend actor and invalidates relevant query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile to the backend and invalidates the current user profile cache on success.
Stub mutation hook replacing the old contact form backend; always throws an error indicating the feature is unavailable.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT collection's name and description via the backend actor and invalidates the collections cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an existing NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook replacing the old artwork upload backend; always throws an error directing users to the new NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that handles image file uploads to the backend actor with progress tracking, format validation, and error parsing.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for a warm luminous color palette in both light and dark modes, plus custom scrollbar styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status with a timeout, then renders tabbed UI for managing NFT collections and individual NFTs with create/edit functionality.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Placeholder artwork detail page that displays a 'not found' message, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displays them as clickable cards with title/date/excerpt, and shows a 'New Post' button for admins.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only blog post creation form with title, content, and optional featured image fields that submits to the backend via the useCreateBlogPost hook.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Individual blog post detail page that resolves a post by ID from either static data or the backend, displaying the title, publication date, featured image, and full content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that submits via the useSubmitContactForm hook and shows success or error alerts.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Gallery page displaying a hero banner, a quote, NFT collections section, NFT explanation, and a CTA link to the NFT gallery route.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT, fetching data by ID and displaying the image, title, description, collection badge, price, and a link to the ICP explorer.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: Full NFT gallery page with authentication-aware UI, collection filtering, tabs for all/issued/owned NFTs, a mint modal, and a detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Upload page allowing authenticated users to fill out a form, select an image, and mint a new NFT to a chosen collection with upload progress feedback.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions to merge static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, find a post by ID, and format timestamps as German-locale date strings.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Async helper that copies a string to the clipboard using the Clipboard API with a textarea-based fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display, optionally truncating the middle with ellipsis.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom theme tokens (colors via oklch CSS variables, fonts, border radius, shadows, keyframes), and plugins including typography, container-queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks project state version 3 with two existing fix features: reducing Gallery page border widths to ~1px and making Gallery quote text lighter weight using the Playfair Display serif font.
